# Fleetify

## Open-source command center for your AI coding agents

4 followers

## Open-source command center for your AI coding agents

4 followers

Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

results.content:
Title: Open Paper: A workbench for academic literature review | Product Hunt
# Open Paper. ## A workbench for academic literature review. File storage and sharing apps. Open Paper gives you a single place to read, annotate, and understand papers with the help of AI. Each AI response is grounded in citation, giving you info you can actually trust. We're building the fastest way to understand research. Dropbox SignSimple, secure eSignatures for the way your team works. ## Open PaperLaunches. Open PaperA workbench for reading and understanding papers. Launched on January 7th, 2026. Open PaperAI-native workbench for understanding papers. Launched on May 31st, 2025. Effective reading and efficient synthesis during R&D, even using it for audio briefings while people in office roles are commuting, overall it is working fine.
